title: Burn the House Down
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Thirteen years after the Mitarai family home burned and her mother took the blame, Anzu Mitarai takes a job under the false name 'Shizuka Yamauchi' as housekeeper to her father's second wife, Makiko, a rising model she suspects of starting the fire (Kodansha blurb via AniList; OASG review). Anzu's mother is hospitalized with amnesia, and Makiko keeps something hidden on the forbidden second floor (OASG). It is a josei revenge mystery serialized in Kiss.
life_message: Uncovering the truth matters, but the story questions what revenge costs the one who seeks it.

content.note: Past house fire (arson) drives the plot; reviewers describe no graphic violence (OASG); Arson, Abusive Family Member/s (MangaUpdates).
Suspense and a hidden person upstairs (OASG); Suspense tag (MangaUpdates).
Reviewers note romance is not the focus (OASG).
Cutting insults such as 'It reeks of poverty' (OASG).
Mother hospitalized with amnesia after flashbacks; a shut-in son (OASG); Trauma, Hikikomori, Sick Parent/s (MangaUpdates).
Anzu infiltrates a home under a false identity seeking revenge (OASG; blurb); Blackmail, Manipulation (MangaUpdates).
Makiko's modeling and social media fame (OASG; MangaUpdates Social Media).

dominant: Revenge and justice; a family broken by a lie; deceptive appearances

delivery.evidence: OASG: a mystery driven by character conflict, not a message-driven work.

winners_losers: Sympathy starts with Anzu and her mother against Makiko, though reviewers find both leads hard to like; outcomes are not in the opened sources.
